acceptance: Accessible picker resolves active project identities; validated UTF-16 spans produce mentions and literal at-name text does not notify.

testNames: comment and card activity reads forward opaque cursors and preserve the next page envelope
versioned comment edit and delete send exact IDs, mention spans and retained operation keys
committed lost reply retries the original comment payload/key through the real API client
quick-add retains expected board version and original explicit priority after an unknown 503
definitive validation refusal permits a new edited intent, in-flight submissions share one request
a synchronous validation failure does not leave the next operation stuck on a rejected request
a later authorization refusal cannot erase an earlier unknown committed operation
cursor pages keep order, replace edited/deleted duplicates and reject cursor loops
roles distinguish author editing from moderation and never grant Viewer write controls
comment create/edit drafts remain actor/card-scoped through remount and clearing one draft keeps the other
edit restores actual UTF-16 spans, leaves malformed spans literal, and IME Enter is ignored
the mention query sends the card id, keyed by card, and the client method puts it in the URL
with a second member, candidates appear and are searchable
a Viewer with board access can be mentioned; someone without a grant or who left cannot
empty wording: loading, failed, only you, no match
listbox pattern: combobox textarea, listbox, options named
saved mentions show the current full name on hover, not the stored text
trigger is found after @ at the start or after whitespace
no trigger inside an email address, after a space, or without @
applyMention writes @Name plus a space and spans exactly @Name
offsets are UTF-16 code units, so emoji and accents before a mention count correctly
typing before a mention moves it; typing after leaves it
editing inside a mention removes it; deleting before shifts left
pasting over a selection that covers a mention removes it
finalize keeps matching spans, sorted, with exact offsets
finalize shifts offsets when the body is trimmed
finalize drops spans whose text changed, overlaps and ones glued to a word
finalize caps at 20 mentions
segments split a stored comment and ignore bad spans
match any word start, ignoring case and accents
a first name, a space and part of the last name narrows to one person
ranking: full-name prefix, then other word starts, then A to Z
matched characters are emphasised on the original spelling
numbered duplicates:
a multi-word query keeps the trigger open while it can match, and closes when it cannot
inserting a full name writes
backspace deletes a whole mention at once, and ignores plain text
ranges still shift after edits with full-name mentions
